pricingTiers.name: Moodle LMS self-hosted
pricingTiers.notes: GPL core has no software license fee; infrastructure and paid Workplace extensions separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: MoodleCloud Small
pricingTiers.unit: site with up to 200 users and5GB storage
pricingTiers.notes: Displayed indicative USD annual amount; actual billing exclusively inAUD. No monthly subscription. Small is a modest organization plan; exact AUD total not retrieved from pricing switch. Taxes/provider conversion vary.

pricingTiers.name: Moodle Premium Solutions
pricingTiers.notes: For flexibility/custom plugins beyond MoodleCloud, official page directs users to Premium Solutions quote. Separate Workplace licensing not priced as core LMS.

moats.claim: An extensive learning activity/plugin ecosystem and accumulated courses, gradebooks and institutional integrations create content/process migration costs.

productReasons.claim: Quizzes, assignments and question banks support multiple assessment and grading workflows.
Forums, collaborative activities and completion tracking support instructor-led and self-paced learning.
Configurable roles, competencies and course-management tools let institutions adapt learning structure to their programs.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: PHP8.4 supported; sodium required; max_input_vars>=5000. Version5.3 requirements, not older Moodle releases.
Managed AWS service; compatibility version8.0 rather than internal Aurora3.x.
Oracle no longer supported fromMoodle5.0; SQLite not a supported production alternative.
One compatible PHP web server; from5.1 web root must point to public/.
Course uploads and user content stored separately from application code; size scales with content.
Scheduled tasks required for normal notifications and maintenance workflows.
External email relay if used; local mail configuration alternative. No mandatory paid mail vendor established.
Core installation does not require an external Redis broker. Search/object-storage plugins can add services but are not base requirements.

resources.memory: 512MB minimum;1GB+ recommended;8GB+ likely for large production
resources.storage: 200MB code plus content;5GB described as realistic minimum
resources.os: Linux typical; Windows server and other PHP-compatible systems documented
resources.notes: Only explicit documented hardware figures included; null means no minimum verified in reviewed installation source.

selfHosting.notes: MoodleLMS5.3LTS released5October2026; PHP/database minima taken from that release, not generic old install pages. Choose one SQL backend. Optional external cache/email/integration services distinguished from required PHP/SQL/file/cron stack.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official installation instructions; no current first-party or officially linked one-click or one-command installer verified. Manual package/Compose instructions excluded.
